data.one_liner: Production-ready FCM actions, tokens, topics, and routing for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Normalizes Firebase Cloud Messaging payloads, manages tokens and topics, handles action buttons, inline replies, and background tasks, and provides typed event streams and route mapping.
use_when: You need robust action buttons, inline replies, and deep linking for Firebase Cloud Messaging.
You want centralized routing and middleware for notification events across multiple platforms.
avoid_when: You only require basic local notifications without Firebase Cloud Messaging.
You are using a push provider other than FCM.
strengths: Handles complex notification flows including background actions and inline replies out of the box.
Supports Android, iOS, macOS, and web with WASM compatibility.
Includes built-in replay protection, payload size limits, and persistent retries.
weaknesses: Requires native configuration steps such as APNs entitlements on iOS and Java desugaring on Android.
Topics are not supported on the web platform.
data.setup_notes: Requires running flutterfire configure, enabling Push Notifications and Background Modes in Xcode for iOS, and adding core-library desugaring dependencies for Android.

alternatives.name: onesignal_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using OneSignal instead of Firebase Cloud Messaging for push notifications.
